name: Sobrato Nonprofit Centers Conference Space
description: Free meeting and conference space for Bay Area nonprofits ranging from 3 to 200 people in Redwood Shores, San Jose, and Milpitas; includes A/V equipment and hospitality areas
fullDescription: Sobrato Philanthropies provides free meeting and conference space to qualified Bay Area nonprofits at its Sobrato Centers for Nonprofits in Redwood Shores (Redwood City), San Jose, and Milpitas.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free meeting and conference rooms
- Spaces for 3 to 200 people
- Audio/visual equipment included
- Hospitality and registration areas
- Free on-site parking; food and drinks allowed
- Locations in Redwood Shores, San Jose, and Milpitas
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a qualified Bay Area nonprofit
2. Apply through Sobrato website
3. Select preferred location and date
4. Describe meeting or event needs
5. Wait for confirmation
6. Follow facility guidelines
keywords: Sobrato, free meeting space, nonprofit venue, conference room, event space, 200 people, multiple locations
